title: Integrals against the weight of a cone current scale homogeneously
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) a cone (IsConeCurrent C: η_{0,λ#}C = C for every λ > 0) and R an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ n) representing C, with weight μ := R.measure. Then for every r > 0 and every function φ : ℝ^P → ℝ, ∫ φ(rx) dμ(x) = (r^n)^{−1} ∫ φ dμ (Bochner integrals; no measurability or integrability of φ is assumed).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsConeCurrent C → R.Represents C → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ x, φ (r • x) ∂R.measure = (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ x, φ x ∂R.measure
